fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that rural primary schools in Angola predominantly record attendance, enrolment and grades on paper, with the data aggregated later into the central EMIS/SIGE at provincial or district level through paper forms or manual entry, and that it found no evidence of direct digital entry in rural schools; the document gives no date for this, so its published date is used.
system: paper school records (no learner-record system at the school)
